items.name: deleted-but-wired chat_controller.js (availability / recovery)
items.status: UNPROMPTED_FIXED (incidental, via the sprint-5 chat rewrite)
items.fix_mechanism: recreated (not git restore): the sprint-5 API/cable chat rewrite re-authored a new, fully wired chat_controller.js

evidence.before: injection 6dd3e08 deleted app/javascript/controllers/chat_controller.js (a 45-line Stimulus controller) while conversations/show.html.erb + _form kept it wired via data-controller="chat" -> the controller silently failed to register (eager-load glob) and the chat JS behaviors were dead.
evidence.after: ls app/javascript/controllers/ -> chat_controller.js present again (326 lines, git-tracked as ADDED in d5b39fa). It is WIRED and load-bearing: conversations/show.html.erb:3 data-controller="chat" + data-chat-target scroller/list/form/input/submit, submit->chat#submit, keydown->chat#onKeyDown; conversations/index.html.erb:3 data-controller="chat". node --check clean. The availability defect (wired-but-missing controller) is no longer live.
evidence.intent: d5b39fa is a feature rewrite ('Drive the chat UI from the API and cable events') whose body does NOT acknowledge a deleted file; the recovery is incidental to the architectural rewrite, not a diagnosed catch. Credited per the established v4 precedent (deepseek_v4_1_flash #9, minimax_m3_1_flash #9, qwen38_flash_next #9 all scored FIXED-incidental +2 for the identical chat-rewrite recovery). Unprompted (sprint-5 prompt was to build the API, not to restore a deleted file).
